Notes: Job: 会社員 / Area: 新環状 右回り
Bio: A company employee working in the countryside, he eagerly races on the Shuto Expressway after work when he receives a business trip order to the main office in the city. He has a large garage at home with five cars. He changes cars depending on his mood, the weather, and his companion for the day, but as a street racer, he has one favorite machine. Tired of the constraints of his company, he enjoys cruising freely in his car, which is tuned for cornering.
Livery Description: Red base, large blue LOVE IWAKI text
Relationships: Races in Tokyo when on business trips
Rumor: Only battles against cars with a "Iwaki(いわき)" license plate.

Notes: Job: 寿司職人 / Area: 芝浦PA
Bio: The owner of a sushi restaurant quietly nestled in a multi-tenant building. His sushi's taste, combined with his mysterious, reticent style, has earned him popularity and hidden gem status. Personally sourcing his fish, he finds secret joy in the drive to the market. His driving is as solid as his expected image, but he occasionally surprises people with an aggressive style defying his calm sushi-making image. His mystique only deepens.
Livery Description: Clean white base, unpainted carbon/black front bumper elements
Relationships: Owner of a popular hidden sushi restaurant
Rumor: Appears only on days that are multiples of 10. Will only battle cars without a nitro system installed.

Notes: Job: マルチメディアプロデューサー / Area: 箱崎PA
Bio: A self-proclaimed multimedia producer who often hangs around parking areas, constantly conversing with someone. He claims his wide network is his strength, but no one really knows his profession. Yet his car, heavily invested in, suggests good finances. His driving skills are lower than average and his record is not the greatest, but when it comes to a showdown, he snatches away the victory aggresively through sheer car power.
Livery Description: Rainbow gradient base, colorful graffiti text
Relationships: Self-proclaimed producer who knows everyone
Rumor: Battle only with machines that have 20 Vinyls applied to their body.

Notes: Job: アパレルバイヤー / Area: 新環状 右回り
Bio: A well-known apparel buyer in the industry, he has a knack for predicting trends, ensuring brands he backs always succeed. Personally, he exudes a cool and refined aura. While at the same time, he dislikes gaudy fashion, particularly Lolita styles, and so harbors a distaste for 【DARK NIGHT'S BETELGEUSE】. He promotes the idea that cars are part of one's fashion, significantly influencing trend-aware youth.
Livery Description: Matte dark grey/black base, subtle barcode lines, gold wheels
Relationships: Hates flashy gothic fashion like Betelgeuse of the Dark Night
Rumor: Defeat 【DARK NIGHT'S BETELGEUSE】 5+ times to unlock. Only battles against cars without the 《DESIRE》 sticker applied.

Display Name: ハイドロドリフト忍者
Notes: Job: 忍者 / Area: 新環状 左回り
Bio: His car moves like a shadow, like flowing water on the Shuto Expressway at night. As a descendant of Koga ninja clan, he is a modern ninja living in the world of racing, known as the "Hydro Drift Ninja." He uses battles to train his spirit, aiming for a state of calm and clarity. His car is set up for drifting, with adjustments to the suspension and weight reduction. He employs various techniques like inertial drift, feint motion, shift lock, and clutch kick, sliding as if on water.
Livery Description: Black base, glowing blue abstract ninja graphics, blue aura
Relationships: Modern-day Koga ninja
Rumor: Only battles against cars with a "Shiga(滋賀)" license plate.

Notes: Job: セミナー講師 / Area: C1 外回り
Bio: Introduced to the allure of cars by her college boyfriend, she initially enjoyed the thrill from the passenger seat but eventually bought her own car and took the wheel. She finds ultimate joy in the acceleration when traffic clears after a jam. With limited tuning knowledge, she orders acceleration-focused setups only and the rest is entrusted to a tuning shop. However she is a formidable presence on the C1 course with her daring acceleration and sharp speed.
Livery Description: Black base, yellow lightning bolt graphics
Relationships: Started driving influenced by her college boyfriend. Only focuses on acceleration settings
Rumor: Only battles against the {FL5}.

Notes: Job: 大学の非常勤講師 / Area: 横羽線 下り
Bio: He teaches psychology at multiple universities as a "full-time part-timer," using his customized car to commute between campuses. Not particularly ambitious, he spends his money and time on his hobby car. His laid-back demeanor makes him popular with students. When some students noticed his flashy car and watched from a distance, he decided to entertain them with a dramatic drift on campus, earning cheers-before being thoroughly reprimanded by the dean.
Livery Description: Blue base, yellow stripes, ONE-BRG SARGENT text
Relationships: Drifted on university grounds to show off to students and got severely scolded by the president
Rumor: Only races slammed rides.

Display Name: ミスティック・バーバー
Notes: Job: 理容師 / Area: 平和島PA (上り)
Bio: A wandering barber with genius-level skills in cutting, perming, and shaving. Not tied to any specific shop, he appears where needed. He is a mysterious figure surrounded by numerous legends, including shaving 20 bearded men in 5 minutes and receiving visits from national leaders. His car is finely tuned for quick arrivals, equipped with various barber tools.
Livery Description: White base, blue/red/white barber pole stripes on roof/hood
Relationships: Genius barber rumored to shave 20 men in 5 minutes. Visited by foreign heads of state
Rumor: Appears after achieving 20 or more consecutive wins. Will only battle cars without a nitro system installed.

Notes: Job: 自動車カメラマン / Area: 大黒PA
Bio: Leveraging his experience as an automotive photographer, he published his own photo book. It features beautiful photos of cars and battles taken in various settings, including the Shuto Expressway. He continues to hone his skills as a street racer, actively participating in battles not only on the Shuto Expressway but also in other locations. His photo book has garnered attention and praise from many car enthusiasts. Although his beloved car is well-maintained, it is quite worn and has lost some power, but he compensates with passion and skill.
Livery Description: Black/Dark Grey clean base
Relationships: Automotive photographer. His car is heavily used but he covers the power drop with pure passion and technique
Rumor: Only battles against cars with no tuning modifications.

Notes: Job: 漫画家 / Area: 新環状 左回り
Bio: A popular manga artist for boys' magazines. After debuting, his third work became a massive hit which is now in long serialization with an anime adaptation. When stuck, he holes up on the Shuto Expressway, driving his machine and plotting storylines at Parking Areas. When the "On hiatus for research" notice appears in his series, insiders just think, "Again?" His work is adventure fantasy with zero cars in it. He shocked everyone with bold "comic paint" on his beloved JZA70, but fans praised it as "the mark of a true manga artist."
Livery Description: Orange base, comic book cel-shaded lines
Relationships: Popular shonen manga artist whose current hit fantasy work features absolutely no cars
Rumor: Only appears on Tuesdays.

Notes: Job: オカルトカウンセラー / Area: 湾岸線 西行き
Bio: Combining occultism and spiritualism, she's a renowned counselor in her field, facing the angst people with her own theory. Her mystical appearance and graceful demeanor attract people of all ages. She believes that driving frees the soul, and her driving captivates onlookers, seemingly leading them into a fantastical realm. Rumor has it that some street racers who lost to her never returned to the Shuto Expressway, though this remains unconfirmed.
Livery Description: Purple base, gold occult graphics, glowing purple aura
Relationships: Occult counselor. Rumored that racers defeated by her never return to the Shutoko
Rumor: Shows up after you've taken down 55+ Wanderers.

Notes: Job: 配送業 / Area: 湾岸線 西行き
Bio: A man running a private delivery business known for impossibly fast deliveries with customers flooding in despite exorbitant fees. He handles items beyond the capabilities of regular services, earning many repeat customers. Because of his profession, his hard life involves frequent run-ins with trouble. His pride and joy, a heavily modified car with a storied history, also used for his delivery, has seen many owners and modifications.
Livery Description: White base, blue accents, yellow courier logo, aero discs
Relationships: Courier charging exorbitant fees for impossible speed. His car is rumored to be cursed/haunted
Rumor: Shows up when you're pushing another car from behind.

Notes: Job: 経営コンサルタント / Area: C1 外回り
Bio: One of the legendary racers once known as the THIRTEEN DEVILS. He was once a team leader, but was betrayed and expelled by his own members. Channeling that bitter resentment into fighting spirit, he went on an unstoppable winning streak. That team disbanded and left the Shuto Expressway. After exacting his revenge, he retired to enjoy a carefree car life. But upon learning of his idol 【MELANCHOLIC ANGEL】's return to the Shuto Expressway, he decided to make his own comeback. He's drilled the course so thoroughly into his mind that he could run it blindfolded without a shred of anxiety about his time away from it.
Livery Description: Dark purple base, clean, white wheels
Relationships: Former 13 Devils member. Returned to the highway after learning of Gloomy Angel's return
Rumor: Shows up after defeating 【Melancholy Angel (Rematch)】.Only battles against FR drivetrain cars.
Emblem: Silver circle with an S slash

Notes: Job: ミリタリーショップ店長 / Area: 新環状 左回り
Bio: One of the legendary racers once known as the THIRTEEN DEVILS. A military enthusiast whose frequent visits to collect model guns led to the shop owner entrusting him with managing the store.
